title: The One-Page Monthly Money Snapshot
hook_text: TWO LISTS SHOW IF YOU'RE AHEAD

beats.say: Two lists and one subtraction tell you if you're ahead or behind.
beats.visual: Extreme low angle of a lone figure sitting under cold fluorescent lighting in an empty subway station at night.

beats.say: Most people track daily coffee purchases, but miss the one number that actually dictates their freedom.
beats.visual: High angle silhouette of a person standing on wet asphalt under sodium streetlights beside an empty highway.

beats.say: You don't need complicated budget software or hours of painful expense tagging to see reality.
beats.visual: Close up on a pair of hands holding a plain blank index card under a single practical desk light.

beats.say: Step one. Open a blank note on your phone or grab a single index card.
beats.visual: Extreme close up on a plain fountain pen resting on coarse paper in a dimly lit foggy room.

beats.say: List everything you own that has real cash value today. Cash, savings, and investments.
beats.visual: Blue hour view through a glass window looking over a dark city skyline shrouded in heavy fog.

beats.say: Step two. Right underneath, list every single dollar of debt you owe right now.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a cold grey concrete underpass with stark shadows cutting across wet asphalt.

beats.say: Add up your credit cards, student loans, and car balances into one blunt total.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a person standing at the edge of a high building overlooking an illuminated city at night.

beats.say: Step three. Subtract what you owe from what you own to find your net worth.
beats.visual: Extreme close up of a retro flip clock clicking over under a single sodium light bulb.

beats.say: Repeat this simple subtraction on the first day of every month to track your trajectory.
beats.visual: High angle shot of an empty concrete staircase illuminated by harsh cold fluorescent overhead lights.

beats.say: Drifting for 10 years without seeing this number can quietly devastate your long-term wealth.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a solitary figure walking along a misty ocean pier during blue hour.

beats.say: Investing $200/month at 8% from age 25 to 65 yields $698,202.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a massive steel bridge structure silhouetted against a deep indigo twilight sky.

beats.say: Starting at 35 yields just $298,072. That 10 years of drifting costs $400,130.
beats.visual: Cold fluorescent light reflecting off a dark wet asphalt street lined with empty industrial buildings.

beats.say: Knowing your single monthly number ensures you catch leaks before decades slip away.
beats.visual: High angle silhouette of a person standing alone on a concrete parking garage roof at night.

beats.say: Follow Quiet Money for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a highway stretching into a distant foggy horizon under a single highway light.

caption:
Stop guessing if you're building wealth or falling behind. Take 15 minutes today to calculate your monthly snapshot.

#money #personalfinance #networth #financialfreedom #moneytips
